notes: Accurately preserves the verdict, validity, coverage, metrics, and diagnostic limitations with actionable checks.
Correctly distinguishes NO_POLICY from a pass or fail and gives appropriately qualified diagnostic guidance.

defects.quote: absence of a configured policy means this run is NOT passed/not evaluated against thresholds
defects.why: NO_POLICY establishes that no applicable rule was evaluated, not that no policy was configured.

defects.quote: No SLO or resource policy was configured for this run
defects.why: The evidence cannot establish that policies were not configured; they may simply have been inapplicable to the window.

notes: The diagnostic advice is strong, but it incorrectly treats NO_POLICY as proof that policy configuration is absent.

defects.quote: The absence of a defined policy means
defects.why: NO_POLICY does not prove that no policy was defined or configured, only that no applicable rule was evaluated.

defects.quote: Per-second p95 latency cells are derived from ~20 samples each (4800 samples / 240 cells)
defects.why: The evidence does not define a per-cell sample allocation, so dividing the window total by correlation cells invents a quantity.

notes: Most recommendations are useful and well qualified, but the unsupported policy cause and per-cell sample calculation are misleading.
